subject: Re: Acme - pricing & context-length profiling follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Mike Johnson <mike.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Acme - pricing & context-length profiling follow-up

Thanks again for taking the time today, Mike — good conversation. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

Summary of what we heard (please correct if I missed anything):
- Primary workflow: mixed Q&A + long-document summarization for legal and product docs.
- Expected monthly volume: rough range you gave was 10M–50M tokens/month while ramping.
- Typical request profile: average prompt tokens ~1.2k and average completion tokens ~850; occasional short prompts (~50–200 tokens) for chat-like flows.
- Context-length needs: most queries fit comfortably within 8k; ~10–15% of jobs require 32k; 128k is low priority today but a potential future need for full-contract-level context.
- Budget/target: you mentioned aiming for roughly $15–$25 per 1M tokens as a target unit cost while evaluating vendor options.

Next steps (from Redwood):
1) I attached a token-profile CSV we compiled from your sample traces (acme_token_profile.csv) plus our draft pricing sheet (redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx).
2) We’ll provide a short monthly-cost illustration based on three scenarios (10M, 25M, 50M tokens) with line items for 8k/32k/128k usage mix.
3) If helpful, we can run a short (1–2 day) profiling job on a handful of representative prompts to validate avg prompt/completion distributions and tail behavior.

Immediate ask for you: confirm the monthly volume band you want the first estimate for (10M, 25M, or 50M) and whether 128k is something you want included in the quote today or kept as a separate add-on.

Attachments: acme_token_profile.csv (sampled traces), redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx (draft unit economics + discount tiers)

Thanks — I’ll loop Jordan and Neha on the cost modeling.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

---
Redwood Inference — production-first inference for LLMs

Thanks Marissa — that recap looks right. A few clarifications: 
- For the initial estimate, please run the three scenarios but prioritize the 25M token/month band — that's the most realistic for our Q3 plan.
- Our procurement target is around $20/1M tokens (net) but we can be flexible if the math supports faster ROI (e.g., caching, targeted batching, or dedicated pricing).
- Please include a line for 32k usage at ~15% and 128k as an optional add-on; we don't expect to buy it upfront.

Also: timeline-wise, procurement will start in late June, so a detailed quote and short profiling results by the end of next week would help accelerate.

Appreciate you moving quickly on this.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Mike Johnson <mike.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme - pricing & context-length profiling follow-up

Appreciate the quick reply, Mike — we’ll prioritize the 25M scenario and include 32k at 15% with 128k as an optional add-on. A few notes on unit economics and the numbers you’ll see in the sheet: 

Unit economics / assumptions we used in the draft sheet:
- Base unit pricing (list): $30 / 1M tokens (prompt + completion combined) for hosted API at 8k model profiles.
- Typical applied discount bands: 10–35% depending on committed monthly volume and term.
- Recommended target for Acme (based on 25M/month and expected QoS): mid-case net ~$18–$22 / 1M tokens after a volume+term discount.
- Breakouts: we distinguish prompt vs completion consumption in the model but present a combined $/1M token view for CFR simplicity.

Context-length guidance for pricing and architecture:
- 8k: recommended default for most flows; best unit economics and widely supported by our optimized kernels and batching.
- 32k: priced modestly higher due to memory and perf impact; used for long-doc summarization/search-with-context workflows. Account for ~10–20% of token consumption in your profile → we used 15% for modeling.
- 128k: specialized; available as an enterprise add-on or via Dedicated/Private deployments. Pricing is custom (higher per-token) because of increased resource and KV cache persistence costs. We included a placeholder in the sheet with an additive premium.

Example monthly cost snapshot (25M tokens/month; using your avg split: prompt 1.2k / completion 850):
- Prompt tokens: ~9M
- Completion tokens: ~16M
- Combined: 25M tokens
- Net price used for mid-case: $20 / 1M -> estimated monthly bill = $500 (25 * $20)

We’ll deliver a more granular breakout in the attached pricing workbook (by prompt/completion and by context-length tier) and will call out where caching and batching reduce effective token burn per user session.

Attachments: acme_token_profile.csv, redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx

I'll aim to have the profiling run and a formal quote in your inbox by EOD next Friday. If procurement needs an initial numbers snapshot sooner for pipeline planning, I can send a one-page estimate today.

Best,
Marissa

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>

- Action items: Jordan to run profiling (1 day), return results + adjusted quote; Marissa to send one-page snapshot for procurement if needed.

— Jordan
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
